messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT EV-7890: embeddings-prod eu-west-1 p99 > 2.2s for 6m. Pager to @sre-rotation. Link: https://observability.redwood/alerts/EV-7890

sam: acknowledged, joining. initial look: queue depth on embeddings-router up, ded-embed-04 showing high GPU mem pressure and OOM kills in the last 15m.

leah: no prod deploys in last 2h from model pipelines. quantize-rc1 finished canary earlier but was limited to staging.

carlos: i see increased cache eviction rate on kv-cache-2, eviction spikes coincide with the p99 spikes. suspect a hot key churn.

nina: autoscaler reports repeated allocation timeout (10s) when trying to scale ded-embed-04; errors: "failed to bind GPU device: no devices available". posting logs: /var/log/autoscaler/ded-embed-04.log

sre-rotation: ok plan: 1) reduce incoming traffic to embeddings-heavy customers, 2) warm/cache hot keys, 3) shift write-heavy prefixes to reserve pool. who can flip lightweight traffic off?

sam: i can add a temporary rate limit rule to the embeddings route to cap user-tier requests to 30r/s. applying now. command:

```
# add route limiter for embeddings
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood/internal/ratelimit -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","limit":30,"scope":"user-tier"}'
```

leah: started cache rewarm for top 500 prefixes. progress ~22% after first 4m. link to job: https://jobs.redwood/rewarm/ev-7890

carlos: moving low-priority burst traffic to overflow cluster ded-embed-05 now. patching router selector. snippet:

```
kubectl -n infra patch svc embeddings-router -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"pool":"ded-embed-05"}}}'
```

nina: autoscaler team notified (pager infra-ops). they've acked and are investigating GPU allocation pool limits. provisioned nodes are pending.

sre-rotation: recording handoff notes for next shift: primary=sre-rotation (until 1900 UTC), secondary=sam. coverage risk: APAC evening window overlaps with maintenance scheduled at 03:00 APAC (ticket infra-MAINT-311). if we still have capacity pressure at night, consider pre-provisioning 2 gpus in ap-southeast.

sam: current customer impact: increased latency for large-batch embedding calls from enterprise customers; a handful of timed-out requests (~0.04% of total) reported by support. leaving a brief for support-ops: "Investigating elevated embedding latency in eu-west-1; partial mitigation in progress; some heavy jobs may see slow responses." will post to #support-ops in 5m.

leah: mitigation checklist for next oncall (direct paste from runbook):
- watch p99/p95 dashboards (embeddings.p99, embeddings.p95).
- check KV cache evictions: `kubectl -n cache logs kv-cache-2 | grep -i evict`
- confirm rewarm % > 80% before removing rate limits.
- if OOMs continue on ded-embed-04, cordon node and drain: `kubectl cordon NODE && kubectl drain NODE --ignore-daemonsets`
- escalation: if allocation errors persist > 10m escalate infra-ops (pager id infra-ops-2).

carlos: leaving run commands for whoever picks up: 
```
# tail recent gpu allocation failures
ssh infra@autoscaler "sudo tail -n 300 /var/log/autoscaler/ded-embed-04.log | grep -i 'bind GPU' -n"

# check router queue depth
curl -s https://observability.redwood/api/routers/ded-embed-04 | jq '.queues'
```

nina: infra-ops reports they've increased GPU pool request limits for eu-west for 10 minutes to let pending pods come up (change id infra-change-912). monitoring scheduling events.

sre-rotation: handoff actions for next primary (sam):
- keep rate limit in place until cache rewarm >= 80% and p99 < 800ms for 15m.
- monitor autoscaler logs; if allocation timeouts restart, coordinate with infra-ops to provision nodes or pull burst capacity from ded-embed-05.
- customer comms: update support-ops and add note to incident page: https://incidents.redwood/EV-7890

sam: got it. i'll be primary after 1900 UTC (taking over then). brief note: if KV eviction rate spikes again, prepare to increase rewarm concurrency (job param --concurrency 8) and consider enabling sticky cache routing for hot prefixes.

leah: leaving a rollback snippet in case the recent model variant needs to be pulled (quantize-rc1):
```
# rollback model deployment
kubectl -n models set image model-quantize model=redwood/quantize:stable
# check rollout
kubectl -n models rollout status deploy/model-quantize
```

carlos: ded-embed-05 overflow is handling ~18% of traffic now, p95 there ~400ms. overall p99 trending down from 2.4s -> 1.0s in last 8m.

sre-rotation: updating incident bot: EV-7890 -> assigned eng-oncall, severity: degraded. posting final handoff: primary after 1900 UTC = sam, secondary = leah. leaving thread open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
